capabilities: Search several research sources by keyword at once
Save selected results as Markdown notes with frontmatter and abstract
Convert PDF text to Markdown and save figures beside the note
Skip results already present in the vault by source id, DOI or URL
Generate optional AI summaries with a user-supplied key
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; the interface is in Korean. Formerly named Labsidian. The optional briefing/ Next.js site is a separate project, not part of the plugin.
problem: Getting public research reports into a vault as readable notes with their text and figures normally means searching each source by hand, downloading PDFs and converting them yourself.

relations.evidence: OpenAlex | Scholarly works worldwide | Free key recommended

requires.name: Gemini, OpenAI or Anthropic API key

summary: Search tool that queries public research sources and saves selected reports as Markdown notes with PDF text and figures.
